polish.text: Hi, I have a question about the pipeline, do you have time now? If no, I can wait.

polish.scene: status update in a team chat
polish.text: I finished the first version of the script, but there is still some problems with the edge cases. I will continue to fix it tomorrow.
I don't agree with this approach, because it will make the code more complicated and difficult to maintain.
Sorry I didn't understand what you mean by 'ablation' here, can you explain more?

polish.scene: rescheduling a meeting with a colleague
polish.text: Can we change the meeting to Thursday? I have a class conflict on Wednesday afternoon.

polish.scene: pointing out a bug to a colleague
polish.text: I think there is a bug in your function, when the input is empty it will crash.
Thanks for your help yesterday, it saved me a lot of times.

polish.scene: message to the team before a meeting
polish.text: I will be late for 10 minutes, please start without me.
Dear Professor, I want to ask if you have time this week to discuss about my thesis progress. I am available on any day except Friday.
Dear Professor Martin, I am writing to ask if it is possible to extend the deadline of the report for three days, because I was sick last week.

polish.scene: email to a supervisor after a meeting
polish.text: Thank you for the meeting today. I will revise the introduction according to your comments and send you the new version before next Monday.
Could you please write a recommendation letter for my PhD application? The deadline is December 15. I can send you my CV and research statement if you need.

polish.scene: chat message to a supervisor (first-name terms)
polish.text: Hi Marie, the experiments are finished, the results are better than baseline by 3 points. I put the table in our shared doc, please have a look when you are free.
Do you want to go to eat hotpot this weekend? I know a new place that is very delicious.
Sorry I can't go tonight, I am too tired and I still have many works to do.
Haha you are so funny, I laughed to death.
Don't be sad, everything will be OK, you already did your best.

polish.scene: recommending a show to a friend
polish.text: I watched this series in one night, it is so addictive, you must watch it.
The weather in Paris is so bad recently, it rains everyday and I have no mood to go out.
Hello, the heater in my room is broken since two days, can you send someone to repair it as soon as possible?

polish.scene: message to an online shop's customer service
polish.text: I ordered a keyboard two weeks ago but I still didn't receive it. Can you check where is my package?
I want to book a table for four people on Saturday night at 7:30, do you still have place?
Can you please don't make noise after midnight? I need to wake up early these days.
I come from China and now I study computer science in Paris. I have been here for two years.
In my opinion this movie is overrated, the story is very normal and the ending is not make sense.

polish.scene: feedback on a colleague's paper draft
polish.text: Your paper is good in general, but I think the related work part is too long and the experiment part lacks of details.

polish.scene: quick reply in a work chat
polish.text: ok I will do it
No worries, take your time.

polish.scene: telling a friend about your day
polish.text: Today was a terrible day. I missed my train in the morning, then I found that I forgot my laptop at home. When I finally arrived to the lab, my supervisor told me the meeting was cancelled. I really want to cry.
I'm really sorry for what I said yesterday. I was in a bad mood and I shouldn't say those words to you.

reply.text: Dear Yufei, thanks for the draft. Could we meet Thursday at 2pm to go over my comments?
Hi Yufei, I'm afraid I'll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow. Would next Tuesday work for you?
hey, any chance you could review my merge request today? it's blocking the release
reply.note: 今天没空，明天上午可以

reply.text: Do you know why the CI is failing on main? I didn't touch anything 😭
reply.note: I don't know either, will take a look after lunch

reply.text: Great work on the demo! The client was really impressed.
Can you give me a rough estimate of when the migration will be done?
reply.note: 大概还要两周，但不太确定，因为测试还没开始

reply.text: Hi Yufei, thanks for your application. Are you available for a 30-minute call next week to discuss the role?
reply.note: 有空，周三周四下午都可以

reply.text: we're getting drinks after work on friday, you in?
I failed my driving test again 😩 third time
omg I just got engaged!!!
can I borrow your charger? mine died
reply.note: 可以，但我五点要走，之前还我

reply.text: what did you think of the movie?
reply.note: 一般，前半段太慢了，但结尾不错

reply.text: Hello, I will need to come by on Wednesday morning to check the boiler. Will someone be home?
reply.note: 周三上午不在，周四可以吗

reply.text: Who used my milk? There's like nothing left 🙄
reply.note: 是我，抱歉，今晚买一瓶还你

reply.text: Do you want to work on the project together this weekend?

reply.scene: message from a stranger about something you're selling
reply.text: Hi, is the bike still available? Could you do 80 euros?
I think me and Tom are breaking up. I don't really know what to do.
Thanks for covering for me last week, you're a lifesaver
We're sorry for the inconvenience. We can offer you a refund or a replacement. Which would you prefer?
Happy birthday Yufei!! 🎂🎉 hope you have an amazing day

reply.scene: feedback from your professor in a chat
reply.text: The results look promising, but I'm not convinced by the evaluation. Have you compared against a stronger baseline?
reply.note: 还没有，下周会加上两个更强的 baseline

reply.text: Thinking of doing a board game night at mine on Saturday. Bring snacks?
reply.note: 去不了，那天要赶 deadline，下次一定

reply.text: How was your vacation? You went to Japan, right?
reply.note: 很好，吃了很多，就是太热了

reply.scene: text from a friend who is upset with you
reply.text: Honestly I felt a bit left out when you guys went without telling me.
reply.note: 道歉，不是故意的，下次一定叫上

zh.text: 我今天状态不太好，脑子转不动。
别提了，今天倒霉透了。
我有点纠结，不知道该选哪个。
这个东西性价比很高，强烈推荐。
你先忙，我不着急。

zh.text: 随便吧，我都行。
我跟他不太熟，就见过一两次。
他说话总是拐弯抹角的，听得我很累。
我已经开始摆烂了，爱咋咋地。
昨天在全班面前讲错了，当场社死。
最近太卷了，大家都在加班。

zh.text: 我就是来吃瓜的，你们继续。
这首歌太上头了，我循环了一整天。

zh.scene: complaining about work to a friend
zh.text: 老板又在给我们打鸡血了。
这个问题我们线下再对一下吧。
我先跟进一下，有消息马上告诉你。
这个需求有点不合理，工期太紧了。

zh.scene: explaining research results to a colleague
zh.text: 我们的方法在小数据集上效果更好，但是训练时间更长。
老师，我想请问一下，这周能不能约个时间聊聊我的论文？
不好意思打扰了，想跟您确认一下面试的时间。

zh.scene: asking a colleague for a favor
zh.text: 麻烦你帮我看一下这个行不行，辛苦了！
下次我请你吃饭，这次真的谢谢你。
我就不去了，你们玩得开心。
恭喜恭喜！太为你高兴了。
这天气热得我怀疑人生。
他讲了半天，我一句都没听懂。
